**Scope**  
We are building a Social Menstruation ios App called InSync. As a user of InSync you can A. track your period B. friend (or defriend) other users. The app will allow you to see your friend’s data.

**Ideal Features & Requirements**

- Log in as a user via Apple ID or phone number  
- Track your period  
  - Sync/push this data with Apple Health  
  - Ingest predictions from Apple Health and display it/have push notifications  
- Get personal recommendations on what to do that day and an overall summary of your state, depending on where in the cycle you are.  
  - See recommendations for a group of users (e.g., in the friend sync score page) based on state etc..  
- Friend other users via Apple ID or phone number (includes accept/reject of requests)  
- See your friend’s period data  
  - See a chronological timeline/feed of all your friends’ data  
  - See a calendar view of all your and your friends’ data month by month  
  - React to your friends’ events in the feed via emojis  
- See a blended profile of you and a friend. This will give you a calculation of how “in sync” you are, with recommendations of what to do together that day.  
- Ability to “boop” your friends

**For the V0**

- We don’t have to have real commendations or a real calculation of how “in sync” you are with a friend. We’re happy to have dummy endpoints that return fake data that we can update later.  
- Instead of tracking your period in InSync and syncing it back to Apple, we will have users track in Apple and just ingest from apple. We want to be a read-only social layer on top of Apple Health.  
  - We also don’t need to have any push notifications for the v0  
- For a V0, the order of things that we want in InSync is as follows.  
  - Auth  
  - Ingest from Apple Health into InSync  
  - Make friends in InSync  
  - See friend data in InSync

**Preliminary Tech Stack**  
We are planning to sync data from Apple Health to start with. Due to this, we cannot use CloudKit based on Apple’s Developer regulations. Instead we are thinking of using React Native and a Supabase backend. We want to use Expo.

For Auth:

- **Client: Add SIWA via `expo-apple-authentication` or `react-native-apple-authentication` (pure RN).**  
- **Server: Store users by Apple `sub` (subject) \+ stable app user id. Simple JWT between app and API.**

For Ingest from Apple Health into InSync:

- Use  **`@kingstinct/react-native-healthkit`**  
- **`Read the following types: HKCategoryTypeIdentifierMenstrualFlow`**

**`For Friend DB we want to use postgres tables`**

**User Flows**

- Users open the app, and land in a feed of events of the people in their friend group  
  - From here, they can select any user associated with an event and be redirected to the “Friend sync score” screen  
  - They can also select the plus button in order to search and request friends  
  - And they should be able to see their notifications and click on the bell to inspect them  
- Separately, on the calendar view screen, they should see who is PMSing on which days. So far, we were thinking of visualizing this via memoji-like faces on specific dates, and an iOS group chat like collapse of many to avoid cluttering  
  - Users should also be able to select their friends on the calendar and see the “Friend sync score”  
- The profile should  
  - Let you select the number of friends that you have today and see a list of them and some info (perhaps what phase they’re in, your high-level sync score)  
    - From there, you should also be able to select any of them to land in the friend sync score screen  
- For the friend sync score, you should have a few actions available to you such as booping your friends, seeing the sync score, and recommendations for what to do (ie maybe take an iron supplement or provide some emotional support to your friend)
